concept: One round white cartoon face with cyan and violet offset accents on black

visual_review.observed: One simple white round face, black half-lidded eyes and slanted mouth, cyan and violet outer accents on black. No clothes, scenery, lettering or book. Colored silhouettes rendered as exposed arcs rather than clearly duplicated circles.
visual_review.result: Face, expression and colored accents remain visible at these tested sizes.
